applications.name: Galvanize
applications.description: Every 15 second(s) the Defender alternates between Charge-Up and Overcharge. While in Charge-Up, hitting into the Defender's Block inflicts a Shock Debuff on the Attacker dealing 200% of their Attack over 6 second(s). While in Overcharge, all of the Defender's attacks are Unblockable, which cannot be prevented by Ability Accuracy modification.
